## Low Tide

I watched the sea go out at break of day,
And all the gulls came down to search the night,
For what the tide had left along the way,
And what the waves had hidden from the light.

The shells lay open on the cold grey sand,
And every pool held pieces of the sky,
I carried what I found within my hand,
And let the rest be taken by and by.

The wind came up and turned the water green,
And far beyond the rocks a bell was rung,
The morning was as clear as I had seen,
And all the songs the fishermen had sung.

So let the tide go out and let it be,
For all I ask is one more day by the sea.
